name: Mercer County, NJ
findings: Mercer County has 2,035 nonprofit organizations. 1,036 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 891 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Mercer County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Mercer County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 891 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 46 research and think tank organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
